deployment.note: Deployment, version and account identifiers were removed on 2026-08-08 when this tree moved into a repository intended to be public. They identified one maintainer's Cloudflare account and a specific deployed Worker; nothing in the measurements below depends on them. Re-measure with test/measure-remote.mjs against your own deployment.

method.note: client-observed end-to-end latency, including the client round trip to the Cloudflare edge; the guest clock does not advance inside a turn on deployed workerd
method.cold: first invoke on an id with no prior residency (wasm boot + migrations + onActivation + turn)
method.warm: median of 20 sequential invokes on one live residency, activation excluded
method.wake: one invoke after 16000ms idle on an Atom with durable state
